title: cognitive-ack/v0 record
description: DRAFT -- NOT FROZEN, authority: none. Schema revision: draft_revision 1. One self-reported acknowledgement recorded by a human inside the same approval operation as a release-approval/v0 event. It records what the approver SAID (acknowledged / held / rejected) about one or more related impact-scan scopes; it is not proof of understanding, carries no score, and gates nothing -- a release-approval/v0 approval completes with or without it. record_id = "sha256:" + sha256hex(JCS(record without record_id)). No property admits a number: there is no place to carry a score or a confidence. See docs/protocols/cognitive-ack-v0.md.

approval_event_id.description: event_id of the release-approval/v0 event recorded in the same approval operation (same commit, joined by the ingester's envelope -- the record cannot carry the hash of the commit that contains it).

principal.description: Same shape as release-approval/v0's principal; the composite check requires JCS equality with the referenced approval event's principal.

basis.description: Fixed by value: this is the approver's own statement, not a proof of understanding.

scopes.description: Related scopes are acknowledged together in one record (one question).

sampled.description: Present (and true) only on records whose scopes are all low-risk: low-risk scopes are recorded only as sampled calibration. A record with any high-risk scope must not carry it.
